inclusion: Primary numeric-tabular FM context selection, optimization, retrieval, batching, or scaling methods relevant to a fixed causal predictor.
Closely adjacent annotation-acquisition work, explicitly separated from labeled-memory selection.
Seminal PFN localization theory and controlled retrieval mechanism evidence.
Backbone releases and compute alternatives needed to assess whether context truncation remains necessary.

exclusion: Secondary summaries, AI-generated paper reviews and news as support for scientific claims; used only to discover primary URLs.
Unverified priority claims or claims of absence based on no search hits.
Independent duplicate cards for multiple versions of one paper; version differences instead recorded in metadata.
Generic tabular pretraining, application papers or LLM prompting without a meaningful context-selection/scaling link.
Sources published after the inclusive cutoff.
Treating code availability or permissive license as established when only an uninspected link exists.
